John / Lisa,

Thanks for the questionnaire and network diagram — that's perfect.

Quick answers to infra Qs:
- Customer-managed subnets: supported. We can deploy Redwood Private into your VPC using our CloudFormation/Terraform modules; you retain control of route tables and NAT/GW. Alternatively, for customers who prefer, Redwood-managed subnets are possible where we control the compute subnets but we provide strict egress controls and transit gateways.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS. For on-prem air-gapped setups, we can integrate with HSM appliances; we will need out-of-band key exchange and a signed runbook.
- Air-gapped/on-prem lead time: typical timeline is 8–12 weeks for an air-gapped staging deployment (pre-procurement + install + validation). We can provide a more detailed checklist once we know the target environment (OS, hypervisor, network constraints).

I've filled section 2–7 of the questionnaire and attached the file here (partial). Marcus will follow up with the architecture diagram annotated against your ACME_network_v1.pdf and a proposed agenda for Wed 24 Jun 10:00 PT — sounds good on our side.

Elliot Price
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
